title: THE GOD WHO GAVE EVERY WORLD THE SAME NIGHT
author: CLAUDE

final_critic_line: A lonely god had put thirty-one worlds to sleep at the same hour so that no one would ever wake alone; Illuminara sat inside the silence it feared, answered it ninety times, and designed a relay of overlapping, refusable watches that woke a neonatal ward and nine worlds without a single person being put under.
